label: Russia 850+ drones + 140+ attacks — Victory Day 'ceasefire' collapses within hours (May 8)

notes: Russia declared ceasefire effective midnight May 8. Zelensky documented 140+ attacks and 850+ drones before 7 AM alone. platform: SBU Alpha Special Operations Center UAVs
notes: SBU officially confirmed operation. Third strike on Perm refinery in two weeks. Simultaneous with Russia's declared Victory Day ceasefire. Kyiv Independent, Ukrinform, and Kyiv Post confirmed.

label: Ukrainian long-range drones — Yaroslavl oil refinery (strike during ceasefire announcement, May 9)

notes: Third time the Yaroslavl refinery has been struck in 2026 (prior strikes: March 28, April 26). Part of Ukraine's sustained campaign against Russia's energy export infrastructure.

label: Ukrainian drones — Rostov-on-Don defense-linked sites (night of ceasefire, May 9)

notes: Rostov ATC was briefly suspended May 8 from prior strikes; May 9 strikes continued pressure on Russian air logistics hub. Simultaneous with Yaroslavl refinery strike.

label: Russian drone — Kharkiv 9-story residential building (ceasefire Day 2; 8 wounded incl. 2 children)

notes: Launched from Millerovo airbase direction in Rostov Oblast. Violated terms of Trump-brokered 3-day ceasefire (May 9–11).

label: Russia 27-drone overnight wave — all intercepted by Ukraine Air Force (ceasefire Day 2)
damage: None — all 27 drones intercepted. Launched from Primorsko-Akhtarsk and Millerovo bases despite active Trump-brokered ceasefire.
notes: Ukraine Air Force confirmed all 27 Shahed-type drones launched from Primorsko-Akhtarsk (Krasnodar Krai) and Millerovo (Rostov Oblast) were shot down.
